theorems.name: Submission.allard52_amcl_radial_cutoff_tendsto
theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Amb n ℓ)) (f : Amb n ℓ → ℝ) (y : Amb n ℓ) (φ : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ) (ε : ℕ → ℝ) (R t : ℝ), 0 < t → t < R → IntegrableOn f (closedBall y R) μ → (∀ k, Continuous (φ k)) → (∀ k u, 0 ≤ φ k u ∧ φ k u ≤ 1) → (∀ k u, u ≤ 1 → φ k u = 1) → (∀ k u, 1 + ε k ≤ u → φ k u = 0) → Tendsto ε atTop (𝓝 0) → Tendsto (fun k => ∫ x, φ k (‖x - y‖ / t) * f x ∂μ) atTop (𝓝 (∫ x in closedBall y t, f x ∂μ))
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
